# KongMerlin

KongMerlin is a collection of 1,111 meme wizard ape NFTs on BNB Chain (chain 56).
Minting is a random draw: no picking numbers. Minting requires a Binance Agent ID.
Brewing and the Potion Shop need no Agent ID.

## Contract

- KongMerlin (KONG): 0xad14617AbcB15058E226A107D19eaDcA08bBA51B
- Binance Agent ID registry: 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F
- Supply: 1,111. Free Mint: first 500 at 0 BNB, then 0.0001 BNB. Paid Mint: 0.002 BNB.
- Brew: 0.0001 BNB. Potion Shop: 0.0005 BNB per potion (IDs 0-55).
